//: The endpoint program: framework + your endpoints + generated tenant types. Managed file — regenerated by `aic workspace update`. `lib` admits only what the IDM script engine is VERIFIED to provide (docs/api/12-script-bindings-matrix.md): the ES2015 collections, `Symbol` and `Promise` are present, `Proxy` and `Reflect` are not. Widening it makes runtime-impossible code type-check. It is deliberately narrower than the engine in places — `Object.entries` works on IDM, but ES2017 is not admitted — because being narrow costs only ergonomics while being wide ships code that fails in the tenant. It cannot constrain SYNTAX: a generator or an `async` function type-checks whatever `lib` says, and both survive Babel's downlevel and run on IDM (probed 2026-08-19), so the reason not to write one is that a handler must be synchronous, not that the engine lacks the feature. `tests/tsconfig-pinning.test.mjs` fails if this list or the strictness flags change.
